main.description: An admin's approval of one node, stored in the network's repo. A grant that never changes, wrapped in a lease that is re-signed on renewal. The record key is the node's IPv4 address, so each address can only be assigned once. Create new approvals; only renewals overwrite.

signature.description: The lease signature, over the whole record including the grant. Made with a full or renew key of the admin who signed the grant.

grant.description: Who the node is and what it may do. Signed once, when the node is approved.

network.description: The network DID. Must match the repo this record is stored in.

owner.description: The account that owns the node. Its repo holds the node's declaration.

ipv4.description: Must equal the record key, and lie inside the signing admin's ipv4Range.

relay.description: Whether this node may act as a relay.

signature.description: Made with a full key of an admin in the current config, over the grant alone, with $type set to is.neuros.descale.network.approval#grant.
